title: Substitutability Classification
description: Structured-output contract for the classification stage (Sonnet 5). Sent as output_config.format with strict:true, so the model cannot return a shape the pipeline does not expect.

chain_group.description: Shared brand key when this location is one of several run by the same operator.

coverage_concerns.description: Competition the model believes exists but Places data cannot see: municipal facilities, employer or apartment-complex amenities, in-home substitutes, businesses too new to be listed.
